prohibitedRoute.why: runCaseArtifacts accepts an EvalCase, uses evalCase.caseId as artifactRef, loads the evaluation fixture, and ALWAYS constructs a truth-bearing CaseReport from Brand and Alcohol acceptable values and classifications. Discarding that report afterwards does not make the invocation truth-free: the truth was read, and the historical case id was used as the artifact reference.
prohibitedRoute.correctionOf: Amendment 1 and the original plan both routed acquisition through runCaseArtifacts. That was wrong and is corrected here, before any acquisition OCR.

requiredInvocationSteps: read the staged image by opaque filename from the mounted staged directory
verify byte length and SHA-256 against truth-free-input-manifest.json
set derivativeSha256 from the truth-free manifest
use the frozen adapter, engine and parser identities from incumbent-configuration-freeze.json
use the fixed preregistered processedAt value

extractionInputBinding.artifactRef: opaqueItemId — never a historical case id
extractionInputBinding.processedAtNote: The incumbent evaluation path's own EVAL_PROCESSED_AT constant. Amendment 2 stated an invented value; corrected here to the repository's own.
extractionInputBinding.ocrEngine: { kind: ocr, engineId: tesseract.js, engineVersion: 7.0.0, modelId: eng } (incumbent-configuration-freeze.json#extractionInputIdentities)

futureScriptImportProhibition.appliesTo: every acquisition-route script added in Stage 2
futureScriptImportProhibition.enforcedBy: src/fixtures/eval/issue-149-acquisition-isolation.test.ts, which fails if any acquisition-route script imports a prohibited module or references a prohibited symbol
futureScriptImportProhibition.note: Neither file exists yet. The test asserts the prohibition against whichever of them exists, so the rule binds the moment Stage 2 adds one.
futureScriptImportProhibition.transitiveClosureOwnedBy: phase 1 trusted host preparation; see acquisition-runtime-isolation-contract.json#runtimeBundle.dependencyClosureGate. The Stage 1 test is first-order source inspection only and is explicitly not a transitive proof.

haltCodes.STAGED_IMAGE_INTEGRITY_FAILURE: staged bytes or SHA-256 disagree with the truth-free manifest
haltCodes.PROHIBITED_ACQUISITION_IMPORT: an acquisition-route script imports the evaluation harness or a governed truth module

identitiesFrozenNote: Every ExtractionInput identity now has an exact value in incumbent-configuration-freeze.json. Stage 2 reads them; it does not invent or rediscover any of them.

canonicalHelperImport.why: The runner must use the frozen reference implementation of canonicalization, the complete-record schema and the fingerprints rather than reimplementing them, because a second implementation could drift.
canonicalHelperImport.priorContradiction: Amendment 3 required the runner to use the helper while it lived at src/fixtures/eval/issue-149-candidate-canonical.ts, which the same contract and the implemented guard both prohibited importing. The helper is moved rather than the prohibition weakened.
canonicalHelperImport.canonicalizationVersionUnchanged: issue-149-candidate-canonical-v1 names the frozen algorithm, not the file path, so the version string is deliberately not renamed by the move

mandatoryProductionDependencyException.why: field-selection.ts imports it directly; the frozen route cannot run without it. Every other module under src/domain/rules/** remains prohibited.

referenceCandidateAdapter.why: The Stage 2 runner must map BrandCandidateDiagnostic to the persisted evidence record through this one adapter rather than reimplementing it. A second mapping could drift from production's shape without any test noticing — which is exactly how a six-key ocrConfidence schema survived Amendment 5.
referenceCandidateAdapter.rankedMembershipRule: final ranked membership is the set of candidates carrying a decision, ordered by production's exported compareCandidateRanking with the original array order as the stable tie-break
referenceCandidateAdapter.comparatorWrapper: compareCandidateRanking reads only candidate.ranking, verified against the function body at the frozen base and asserted by the compatibility test, so a minimal { ranking } wrapper is faithful
referenceCandidateAdapter.usingTheModuleIsNotSufficient: Naming the adapter module is not enough: the runner must call the COMPLETE-ARRAY function. Per-candidate routes bypass every array-level invariant.

candidateEmissionApi.firstArgument: the complete ExtractionDebug returned by extractLabelEvidenceDetailed (src/pipeline/extractor/extractor.ts#ExtractionDebug)
internalSteps: require debug.passes to be a non-empty ordered array
reconstruct the exact production Brand pass set: primary OBSERVED ? [debug.passes[0]] : debug.passes
perform the complete parity assertion internally against debug.finalSelections.brand
derive candidates only from the internally created diagnosticSelection.brandDiagnostics.candidates
assert the emitted count equals the internally derived diagnostic count
supersededRoutes: a bare candidate array (Amendment 8 and earlier)
a caller-supplied FieldSelection (Amendment 9): a filtered population could be wrapped in a freshly constructed selection and accepted — the Amendment 9 tests themselves demonstrated the bypass
candidateEmissionApi.whyDebugOwned: ExtractionDebug already exposes the ordered passes, the primary selections and the authoritative final selections. Taking it closes the derivation structurally: there is no caller-reachable point at which the population can be filtered, projected or replaced.
candidateEmissionApi.runtimeExportSurfaceVerifiedBy: importing the module namespace and inspecting its actual runtime own keys, not a source regex

haltCodes.DEBUG_PASSES_ABSENT: debug.passes is absent, not an array, or empty
haltCodes.BRAND_DIAGNOSTIC_SELECTION_PARITY_FAILUR: the internally derived selection differs from debug.finalSelections.brand once only filterChecks and activeRejectionReasons are removed
haltCodes.COMPLETE_DIAGNOSTICS_ABSENT: the internally derived selection carries no brandDiagnostics.candidates array
haltCodes.CANDIDATE_EVIDENCE_TRUNCATED: the emitted record count does not equal the internally derived diagnostic candidate count

keptPopulationMustRetainARankedSurvivor.relation: (any candidate is kept) === (at least one candidate carries a decision)
keptPopulationMustRetainARankedSurvivor.why: Production always builds a non-empty ranked list and assigns exactly one selected decision whenever kept candidates exist. A kept candidate may individually lack a decision only because family reduction or deduplication removed it — which requires that another kept candidate survived.
whenAtLeastOneKeptCandidate: at least one decision-bearing final ranked member
ranked positions are unique and contiguous
every ranked member carries score and ranking semantics
keptPopulationMustRetainARankedSurvivor.priorGap: The array adapter derived membership from candidates carrying a decision and checked selection only when that set was non-empty. If every kept candidate's decision disappeared, the ranked set was empty and every record still passed.
